name: Slider
description: Slider extends native range input properties and renders a labeled range control with optional value tooltips and tick marks.

elements.name: label
elements.description: The accessible label for the slider. This prop is required.

elements.name: value / defaultValue
elements.description: Controls the current value or sets the initial value. Use value with onValue for a controlled slider.

elements.name: onValue
elements.description: Called with the current numeric value whenever the slider changes.

elements.name: min / max
elements.description: Set the minimum and maximum values of the range. Defaults are 0 and 100.

elements.name: step
elements.description: Sets the interval between selectable values and determines the spacing of tick marks when tick is enabled.

elements.name: unit
elements.description: Appends a unit to the displayed thumb value and to the generated accessible value text.

elements.name: tooltipThumb
elements.description: Controls the thumb value tooltip: hover (default), always, or never.

elements.name: tick
elements.description: Displays tick marks based on the range and step.

elements.name: hideLabel
elements.description: Hides the visible label while keeping it available through aria-label.

elements.name: position
elements.description: Places the label at the top (default) or left of the slider.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Sets the shared component size to sm, md, or lg.

elements.name: height
elements.description: Sets the track height using a CSS length. Defaults to 7px.

elements.name: aria-valuetext
elements.description: Overrides the generated accessible value text. When unit is provided and this prop is omitted, the unit is appended automatically.

elements.name: labelProps
elements.description: Passes native label properties to the outer container.

elements.name: Native range properties
elements.description: Native range input properties such as disabled, required, name, and id are forwarded to the input.

accessibility.general: The component uses a native input type="range" and associates it with the supplied label. Native keyboard interaction, range semantics, and form behavior are preserved.
elements: Always provide a meaningful label. When hideLabel is enabled, the label is exposed through aria-label.
Use aria-valuetext when the numeric value needs a more descriptive spoken representation. The unit prop provides a simple automatic alternative.
The visual thumb tooltip and tick marks are supplementary; the native range input remains the semantic and keyboard-operable control.
The component sets aria-valuetext only when a unit is provided or an explicit value text is supplied.
